evidence.howTo: Click: found ✓ → absent ✕ → empty. Right-click: absent directly. Use ✕ next to a ghost to eliminate it manually.
evidence.reducedNote: Only {n} evidence is shown on this difficulty; some may never appear. ★ evidence is always shown.
evidence.speedBar: Measured speed: {v} m/s ({lo}–{hi}). ⚡ matches a normal speed; dimmed ghosts can never reach it.
evidence.speedMatch: One of its normal speeds matches the measurement
evidence.bloodMoon: Blood Moon on: speed readings assume ghosts are 15% faster. Resetting for a new contract turns it off.

settings.analyticsHint: When the app opens it sends a single count with only the app version, Windows version and language. Nothing about who you are or your games is sent. It helps us see how many people use the app.

ghost.rulesOut: If you see this, it is NOT this ghost:
ghost.fakeHint: Fake evidence that always appears (not counted)

speed.tapHint: Press {key} or click here on every footstep
speed.irregular: Your tap rhythm varies a lot: the ghost's speed probably changed while measuring. Reset and measure a steady stretch.
speed.reachTitle: Could also be this fast: if it saw someone recently ({n})
speed.reachHint: A ghost speeds up when it sees someone and stays fast for ~1 minute after. That's why you can measure a high speed even while hiding. Don't rule these out by speed.
speed.how: Most reliable: measure while hiding, early in a hunt. Tick the box if the map has a Blood Moon.

timers.incenseIdle: Press {key} when you incense the ghost.

incenseStatus.safeAll: No ghost can hunt (except cursed hunts).
incenseStatus.demon: Demon can hunt now; others can't yet.
incenseStatus.normal: Normal ghosts can hunt; Spirit can't yet.
incenseStatus.spirit: Incense protection over; every ghost incl. Spirit can hunt.

timers.noteUnder60: Hunt started {s} s after incense. Even a Demon waits 60 s; the incense may have missed, or it was a cursed hunt.
timers.noteUnder90: Hunt started {s} s after incense (before 90 s) → most likely a Demon. Not a Spirit.
timers.noteUnder180: Hunt started {s} s after incense (before 180 s) → not a Spirit.
timers.noteOver180: Hunt started {s} s after incense; this rules nothing out.
timers.huntIdle: Press {key} when a hunt starts. Press again if it ends early.
timers.huntRunning: Hunt in progress. It ends when the timer runs out (estimate).
timers.cooldownDemon: Demon can hunt again (20 s); others at 25 s.
timers.cooldownDone: Cooldown over: the ghost can hunt again
timers.cursed: A cursed hunt happened this contract (+20 s)

about.title: About
about.disclaimer: An unofficial, fan-made helper tool. Not affiliated with Kinetic Games. Phasmophobia is a trademark of Kinetic Games.
about.sources: Ghost and item info is compiled from community sources and may change with game updates:
about.updates: The app downloads new versions itself; "Update now" at the top updates and restarts it in a few seconds. If you don't click it, the update installs when you close the app.

update.ready: v{v} is ready. Click to update; the app restarts in a few seconds.
update.installing: Updating, the app will reopen shortly…

shortcutEditor.hint: Click to change, then press the new key. Esc: cancel · Backspace: remove shortcut.
shortcutEditor.risky: Careful: {key} on its own may be a key you use in the game. The shortcut takes it away from the game.
shortcutEditor.unsupported: This key can't be used as a shortcut.
shortcutEditor.failed: These shortcuts are taken by another app and don't work: {list}
shortcutEditor.failedOne: This key is taken by another app

maps.sameAsUnverified: No separate source; showing {name} locations, which may differ.
